d:
From the fire at Gaffar Market to the deadly building collapse in Chawri Bazar, a series of incidents has raised questions about building safety in Delhi.
Rapid urban expansion, unauthorised construction, overcrowding and weak enforcement have left many buildings vulnerable. The Delhi Fire Services has also flagged gaps in fire-safety compliance, manpower and infrastructure.
Why does Delhi continue to face such incidents? What are the gaps in building regulation and fire preparedness? And what needs to change to prevent the next disaster?
